native_title: イケメンと同棲する場合
description:
After enduring a hellish two-hour commute to school each way, Kyung-woo finally gets his wish of living alone! However, his joy is short-lived, as his classmate offers to double his investment, and he ends up skipping all of his moving expenses. Out of pity, one of his seniors introduces him to a friend who lives alone in a large house, and Kyung-woo takes up residence there.

The owner of the house, Tae-hee, is very happy to accept Kyung-woo for the first time, and Kyung-woo is moved by this, but it seems that he and Tae-hee have a past that he had forgotten about...?
